arm_j1.name: arm_j1
arm_j1.description: Course arm, base yaw joint 1 (vertical axis: no gravity torque, the MR 'horizontal plane' case), other joints locked at q_home = (0, -0.6, 1.4, -2.4, -1.57, 0) rad, 0.25 kg payload at the tool point. Torque and speed limits derated to 60 % / 50 % of the rated values (Course resources: Course robot models and hardware safety checklist). b illustrative.
arm_j1.source: course_arm.py = shared course robot model course_arm(payload=0.25); M = MassMatrix[0, 0]

arm_j2.name: arm_j2
arm_j2.description: Course arm, shoulder joint 2 (horizontal axis), other joints locked at q_home, 0.25 kg payload. g(q) = g_cos cos q + g_sin sin q from modern_robotics GravityForces. Derated limits. b illustrative.
arm_j2.source: course_arm.py = shared course robot model course_arm(payload=0.25); M = MassMatrix[1, 1]

knee.name: knee
knee.description: Powered transfemoral prosthesis, knee joint, thigh hanging vertically (hip q1 = -90 deg locked): q = knee flexion = -theta2 of leg_prosthesis_2r (positive = flexion; 0 = straight leg), g(q) = m g r sin q. Shank + prosthesis 2.4 kg, CoM 0.21 m below the knee, I_zz = 0.045 kg m^2 about the CoM. b, torque and speed limits illustrative.
knee.source: shared course robot model leg_prosthesis_2r (461 Week 3 'leg_2r'); M = I + m r^2

eod_wrist.name: eod_wrist
eod_wrist.description: EOD robot arm (protective use), wrist pitch joint 3 carrying the 2 kg suspect package, shoulder and elbow locked with the forearm horizontal (q1 + q2 = 0): g(q) = m g r cos q. Link 3 = 3.5 kg, CoM 0.10 m from the wrist axis, I_zz = 0.008 kg m^2. b, torque and speed limits illustrative.
eod_wrist.source: shared course robot model eod_3r (461 Weeks 1-3); M = I + m r^2

mr_link.name: mr_link
mr_link.description: The single-joint robot of MR Sec. 11.4.1 (Eqs. 11.19-11.21, p. 424): M = 0.5 kg m^2, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m, b = 0.1 N m s/rad, vertical plane (g = 9.81). Used to reproduce MR Fig. 11.13.
mr_link.source: Modern Robotics Sec. 11.4.1, printed p. 424 (not illustrative)
